decision.explanation: The query asks for the person or organization Oktay Aktas worked for. Document D1 explicitly states in its conclusion (D1S16) that 'Oktay Aktas had indeed worked for Osaka University,' supported by narrative details about his time there (D1S2-D1S15). Document D2 explicitly states that 'One of the notable affiliations in his career is his work with Xi'an Jiaotong University' (D2S3) and confirms this via his ResearchGate profile (D2S6). Both documents provide direct assertions regarding his employment/affiliation. Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist (different employers for the same person), both universities are included as valid answers.
